exact_statement: For nearest-neighbor zero-field Ising on Z at beta>0, t=tanh beta and q=e^(-2 beta), the source-normalized d=1 coupling equals g_1(beta)=(-log t)(q-3/q), and its beta->infinity limit is -6.
assumptions: definition of g extended to d=1
proof_or_counterexample: Transfer-matrix leading eigenvalue e^beta(cosh h+sqrt(sinh^2 h+q^2)) has magnetization sinh h/sqrt(sinh^2 h+q^2). Its cubic coefficient yields cumulant density q^(-1)-3q^(-3). With G(0,x)=t^|x|, chi=1/q and xi=1/(-log t); substitution and the t->1 limit prove the formula.
remaining_gap: One-dimensional beta_c is infinity and provides no three-dimensional lower bound on current intersections or g_3.
status: proved special case; independent review pending
